context:
Goal: one direction for watches, wakes, sweeps, reaps and logs (plan align-watchers, Q6).
Problem (rule): your rule gives each capability one home. Load has two definitions, so only your word picks one home or a stated reason for two.
Based on (read): the guard reads memory and disk. sim-lease reads vm.loadavg, and it already states its own definition (plan align-watchers, section 3, lane watchers-one-rule).
Departs from: main, with two load definitions and no record of why — adds one record that says why (b), or one shared definition (a).
Meanwhile: the watchers lanes go on; none waits on this.
lane: coordinator: the watchers lanes run from plan align-watchers

options.gain: One home for load, so the two never disagree.
options.how: The guard and sim-lease read load from one shared place.
options.label: One shared definition
options.lose: A lane rewrites both readers, for low value.

options.gain: No code change, and the reason is written down.
options.how: Keep both definitions, and one record says why each one reads what it reads.
options.label: Keep two, record why
options.lose: Two definitions can still drift apart.

title: The guard and sim-lease each define "the machine is loaded" their own way. Merge them into one?
why: Low value: two definitions of load can disagree, but each one states its own today.
